ticket.subject: App not loading for anyone
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

The app does not load for anyone at Brambleway Studio: we get a blank page and a spinner that never ends.

We tried different networks and browsers. Contacts at two other companies tell us they see the same thing.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Is there an incident on your side?

Best,
Henrik Castellano
operations manager, Brambleway Studio
